scope: Verify OBJECTS section rollback after the core has staged an IMAGEDEF graph, followed by same-writer retry and typed readback.

behavior: The IMAGEDEF plan failure/retry control injects a malformed XRECORD value from the consumer OBJECTS callback after the core has emitted its NOD, GROUP, IMAGEDEF dictionary, reactor, and IMAGEDEF records.
A second callback mode injects std::bad_alloc while constructing a probe after those core OBJECTS records have been staged; the top-level writer reports phase Allocation and code allocation-failure.
Both failed attempts preserve the pre-existing destination sentinel and clear derived entity identity maps.
Correcting the callback on the same writer must succeed; a fresh typed DXF import verifies the IMAGE, IMAGEDEF, reactor references, and independent XRECORD.
The sequence runs for ASCII and Binary DXF. It adds no repository DWG/DXF fixtures and establishes no support claim.

normalFocused.coverage: Both ASCII and Binary generated IMAGEDEF flows; earlier entity-callback failure, later OBJECTS callback validation failure and callback bad_alloc after core records were staged; destination preservation, identity rollback, corrected same-writer retry, and fresh typed readback.

limitations: The bad_alloc is injected in the consumer callback after the core OBJECTS records are staged; allocation failures inside each core OBJECTS builder remain open.
The generated round-trip is local transport evidence; native consumer semantics, physical producer breadth, and independent interoperability remain unqualified.
next: Inject allocation failures inside independent core OBJECTS builders and extend rollback controls to other staged families.
